text: Customer reports they cannot log in since this morning. They reset their password twice and the reset email arrives, but the new password is rejected with "invalid credentials".
The customer was charged twice for the October invoice. Both charges appear on their card statement on the same day for the same amount, 240 euros.
Exporting a report to CSV produces a file with garbled characters in every name containing accents or umlauts. The customer opens the file in Excel on Windows.

Since the release on Tuesday, calls to the orders endpoint return HTTP 429 after about 50 requests per minute, although the documentation states a limit of 300 per minute for their plan. Their nightly sync job now fails halfway and retries until morning.
An administrator deleted a shared project by mistake while cleaning up old workspaces. The project contained six months of design files and comments from twelve people.
The mobile app crashes immediately on launch for one user after updating to version 5. 2 on an older Android phone.
